notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings, bushcrafters!

Over the past month, the game has gone through a lot of testing in preparation for one of the most requested features. And now it’s here: the save system is officially enabled in the demo version!

With this addition comes one important note: during development, updates may make older save files incompatible. It’s a necessary step for now, but once the game reaches full release, save files will be stable. Although testing has been extensive, some bugs may still appear. If you encounter any, please share them. The best way is through the discord.

Meanwhile, work continues on the endgame and survival mechanics. These will challenge players to prepare wisely, but ultimately, nature will decide the final outcome. The game is now around 85% complete: the core systems are in place, and the focus is shifting towards the end game, fine-tuning and balancing the mechanics.

Got feedback? Join the Discord and share it! https://discord.gg/8EH6vW94

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Save system enabled
- Players can now save progress in the demo
- Note: older save files may come incompatible (will be informed)
[*] Medical treatment system
- New wound types: Wound, deep wound, and infected wound
- Wound: slowly heals on its own, but healing can be sped up with any bandage
- Deep wound: Does not heal naturally, can be treated with any bandage
- Infected wound: Does not heal naturally, requires an antiseptic bandage
[*] Player temperature update
- Perceived temperature now drops below 0 when the player feels cold
- A neutral zone has been added where the player feels neither cold nor hot
- If world temperature + gear warmth rise too high, the player begins to overheat. While overheated, hydration decreases much faster
- Fire warmth doesn't contribute to overheating
[*] Set Out Tool for Inventory Items
- Items in the inventory can now be “Set Out” directly with a right-click, allowing the player to start moving them on the ground immediately
- Previously, this required dropping the item, closing the inventory, locating it on the ground, and then right-clicking to move
[/list]


[b]Minor Updates & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Building placement now highlights colliding items in red
[*] Added a quick-access button for the foliage removal tool
[*] Tweaked building and some items durability values
[*] Few new items added
[*] Fixed: rainwater was not filling open pots or rain collectors
[*] Added popup descriptions for icons
[*] Item add/drop UI info is now shown for most related actions
[*] Difficulty levels rebalanced: harder levels now feature faster metabolism, item decay, and building decay. 
[*] Spawn rates fine-tuned
[*] Campfires and fire stands now start with fuel based on the raw materials added
[*] Placement controls for roofs, lean-to shelters, and deadwood shelters adjusted
[*] Minor UI improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!

[i]- Feralless games[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings, bushcrafters!

This update is a little bit bigger one, including lots of bug fixes, gameplay adjustments, and UI improvements. Many long-standing issues have been addressed, smoothing out rough edges.

While solving a good number of bugs, there are still a few elusive ones “hiding in bushes”. Tracking them down is an ongoing process, but the hunt is going well, and each step forward brings the game closer to a more stable and better experience.

In the next update, the bleeding system will be refined to feel more immersive and slightly eased for players

Got feedback? Join the Discord and share it! https://discord.gg/8EH6vW94

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cracked trees
- New tree type that requires fewer chops to harvest.
- Beware: in windy weather, some cracked trees may fall. Avoid building too close!
- Can be identified by cracks along the trunk, but spotting them takes a bit of observation.
[*] Quick torch
- A faster, easier torch to craft (no grease-based set material needed).
- Burns out faster than regular torches.
[*] Inventory Item Swapping
- You can now swap items directly in your inventory, making it quicker to organize without extra hassle.
[*] Flat stone spawns
- Flat stone locations have always been a bit of a mystery — until now.
- They now appear in specific rock formations, giving players a clearer idea of where to search.
- Spawn locations are still completely random for each new game.
- Easier difficulties will spawn more flat stones than harder difficulties.
[/list]

[b]Minor Updates & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Awake, calories, and hydration percentages are now displayed in the player panel
[*] Removed the wedge requirement when chopping logs.
[*] Subtitles added to the opening cutscene.
[*] Added some greenish colors to highlight raw materials belonging to a set.
[*] Fixed an issue where torches could not be crafted on a flat stone.
[*] Corrected an issue where some fish would turn into the wrong fish type after cooking.
[*] Fixed thunder weather improperly persisting e.g. during sunny weather.
[*] Some daylight colors adjusted.
[*] Fine-tuned player gravity and jumping.
[*] Plant fiber can now only be obtained from certain woody type foliage.
[*] Minor UI improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!

[i]- Feralless games[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings, bushcrafters!

Behind the curtains I have been focused on the development of seasonal transitions, environmental textures, and underlying game mechanics. Bog holes have been introduced in swamp regions. These areas reduce movement speed and pose a deadly risk if ventured into too far, resulting in the player sinking and dying.

For the demo an optional minigame system has also been added, offering an alternative to RNG-based actions by allowing player input to influence success.

Got feedback? Join the Discord and share it! https://discord.gg/8EH6vW94

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minigame option
- At the start of a new game, players can choose whether to enable a minigame for specific actions like crafting and fire starting. This adds an interactive element in place of purely chance-based outcomes.
[/list]


[b]Minor Updates & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bait can now be attached to the fishing rod
[*] UI now scales correctly across different screen resolutions
[*] New ground foliage visuals introduced for added variety
[*] Minor UI improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!

[i]- Feralless games[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings, bushcrafters!

This update brings some new features, improvements, and refinements based on continued development towards the full game. From environmental additions to deeper gameplay mechanics, here's what's been added and changed in this version.

Regarding the full game the flood and drought systems have been reworked. During the drought players will struggle to find food and water, so preparing this period is essential. Flood will destroy all the structures built by the player from its way. Both of these are optional and can be turned off when starting a new custom game or choosing easier difficulty.

Surviving winter brings new challenges and opportunities. A dynamic snow system blankets the landscape, gradually building up and affecting movement — but it can be cleared when needed. Lakes and rivers freeze over, allowing for ice fishing as a vital source of food. However, resources are scarcer, temperatures are harsher, and only the well-prepared will endure the long cold season.

Got feedback? Join the Discord and share it! https://discord.gg/8EH6vW94

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cordage crafting update
- Cordage crafting has been reworked to reflect the broader availability of plant-based materials in nature. A new raw material, plant fiber, is now essential for crafting cordage.
- Plant fiber can be gathered by harvesting roots or removing plant foliage from the ground.
- The fiber yield from roots varies depending on the harvesting method (using a knife provides better results than collecting by hand).
[*] Fishing update
- You can now catch fish using a fishing rod.
- Ice fishing is available during winter, allowing year-round fishing opportunities.
- New fish species have been added, with different bodies of water offering unique combinations.
- Future updates will introduce bait options and further fishing enhancements.
[*] Tree Felling Update
- All tree types can now be chopped down.
- Tall trees yield 3 large logs, while smaller trees provide 2.
- Be careful! Falling trees can injure the player if you're standing underneath.
- A falling tree may knock over nearby trees, creating a chain reaction.
[/list]


[b]Minor Updates & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] To complement the reduced movement during strong winds, immersive wind sound effects have been added.
[*] A new visual meter displays gained experience more clearly.
[*] Moss can now be found growing on bedrock surfaces if lucky. Keep an eye out for large, static rocks with visible moss as clues.
[*] The firemaking interface now clearly shows what’s required. Whether you need tinder, a firestarter, or both.
[*] Minor UI improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!

[i]- Feralless games[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings, bushcrafters!

Focusing on refining the core game mechanics and integrating various systems. Resource spawns, player metabolism, and wildlife behavior have been adjusted to support more engaging and tangible gameplay. Stimulants now provide temporary boosts to enhance survival chances. A new tool, Remove Foliage, lets you clear out unwanted vegetation to better manage your surroundings.

Got feedback? Join the Discord and share it! https://discord.gg/8EH6vW94


[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stimulants
- Certain edible or drinkable items now provide stimulant effects, such as reduced fatigue, improved health regeneration, enhanced stamina recovery, and increased focus
- Food poisoning immediately cancels all active stimulant effects
- New stimulant-related items added: bone broth, nettle tea, and animal liver
[*] Remove foliage tool
- A new tool that lets you easily clear ground foliage during seasons when it’s present
[*] Environmental updates
- Trees may now fall during stormy weather, adding dynamic hazards and resources
- Bird nests and beehives can now be knocked down with arrows or stones using improved mechanics
- Stone and brushwood spawn rates have been rebalanced for better resource distribution

[/list]

[b]Minor Updates & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added visual effects to indicate the state of dead animals, fire sources, and rainwater collector
[*] UI Codex update for quick crafts
[*] Caves now feature light holes that provide subtle natural lighting
[*] Improved bow mechanics and responsiveness
[*] Added item piling functionality for most items
[*] Updated player metabolism rates
[*] Optimized wildlife behavior and performance
[*] Refined construction models for improved visual consistency
[*] Minor UI improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!

[i]- Feralless games[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings, bushcrafters!

The (demo) game has undergone some fundamental changes, and I’m excited to finally share them with you. Updates can be found below.

Development of the full game is progressing well, though there’s still plenty ahead: implementing the travois, adding Winter and Spring seasons, refining spawn mechanics throughout the year, building the map system, balancing gameplay across difficulty levels, generating the rest of the world, designing the end game, possibly adding Steam achievements, and overall polish to gameplay.


Got feedback? Join the Discord and share it! https://discord.gg/8EH6vW94


[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shelter can now be set on a non-flat terrain
- Totally flat area requirement has been removed from shelter placement. 
- There are still restrictions for terrain type and slope limit. So you might need to dig/raise one or two corners.
[*] Cave system
- Caves are dark, cold environments where players can discover valuable raw materials.
- A torch is highly recommended for exploration, as navigating without light is difficult.
- Loot items won’t be highlighted in a cave.
- One cave can be also found in the Demo game area.
[*] Versatile torches
- With the introduction of caves, torches needed to become more versatile. Players can now light torches directly with a fire starter and chain the flame from one torch to another.
- When igniting a torch using a fire starter, no additional tinder is required. Torches now have “built-in tinder,” determined by the tinder used during their crafting.
- Standard fire restrictions still apply, such as wind and rain.
[*] Stones mechanism update
- Gray stone has been renamed to Chert. Chert will be the most common stone, which can be used as earlier. Chert stone durability has been decreased.
- Red stone has been renamed to Granite.
- Some changes have been implemented to stone related crafting recipes.
[/list]

[b]Updates & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some new rock textures are introduced
[*] Updates to rock spawns
[*] Time pass UI update
[*] General UI changes
[*] Minor bug fixes and updates
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!

[i]- Feralless games[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings, bushcrafters!

I've been closely listening to your feedback, and I'm excited to bring you a new update to the demo! Your insights on the mechanics and areas for improvement have been incredibly valuable, and this update includes key refinements, fixes, and tweaks based on your suggestions.

Join to discord: https://discord.gg/8EH6vW94


[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Inventory crafting has been implemented
- Now basic items can be crafted directly in the inventory without a flat stone
[*] Player perceived temperature
- Character panel shows the current “feels like temperature”, which is affected by ambient temperature, wind, wetness, heat sources etc.
- Player feels cold below a certain temperature, which varies between difficulties. Can be also edited in custom settings.
[/list]

[b]Updates & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Used raw materials and durability are now displayed while crafting
[*] Afflictions are now displayed with a list with percentages
[*] Character panel UI reorganized
[*] Stick shelter add-ons have now been fixed. Earlier couldn’t access a stick shelter, if add-on was incomplete
[*] Construction enhancements were applied while the construction add-on wasn’t completed. This is fixed now.
[*] Animal movement fixes
[*] Occasionally items might get jammed in the inventory, while adding to a slot. This has been debugged, but if this still occurs. #bug-report in discord or steam forums.
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!

[i]- Feralless games[/i]

[list]

[*] Various small bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and happy surviving!
